name: Mei King
source:
Cain Asbell was an unremarkable guy until one of his stray sheep led him into a cave with a trapped fairy named Elise. In a blink of an eye Cain goes from pauper to Lord when Elise helps him rescue the Princess Charlotte. There's just one hitch. Cain has to make his land the most prosperous in the country within 5 years. Should he fail, he'll lose everything and return to being another lowly shepherd. But if he manages to succeed, Cain will gain the Princess Charlotte's hand in marriage!

Sound easy? Not if everyone in your kingdom is out to take advantage of your young age. Between slavers and bandits it's amazing that Cain is still alive. But being a Lord isn't all bad - he has the right to choose any woman he wants... Tsubaki, who doesn't fully appreciate that her body has a will of its own, Tia, who will do anything for the man that saved her, and Chiffon, whose cold heart has yet to feel real passion...

[from [url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=647]AniDB[/url]]
translation:
该隐·阿斯贝尔原本是个不起眼的家伙，直到他的一只迷途羔羊将他带入了一个洞穴，里面困着一只名叫艾莉丝的妖精。在艾莉丝帮助他救出夏洛特公主的那一刻，该隐从穷光蛋变成了领主。只不过有一个条件：该隐必须在5年内将自己的领地建设成全国最繁荣的地方。如果失败，他将失去一切，重新变回一个卑微的牧羊人。但如果成功，该隐就能迎娶夏洛特公主！

听起来很简单？如果你王国里所有人都在觊觎你年轻的年龄，那就不简单了。在奴隶贩子和强盗的威胁下，该隐能活下来就已经是奇迹了。但当领主也不全是坏事——他有权选择任何他想要的女人……椿，还没有完全意识到自己的身体有着自己的意志；蒂亚，愿意为救了她的男人做任何事；以及雪纺，那颗冰冷的心尚未感受过真正的激情……
